summary: A mixer of up to 24 inputs, one track each, with a fader, pan (balance on stereo, constant power on mono), mono, mute and solo per track, a master fader and mute, and fades over Inertia; each track also has a direct out.
use_for: A small mixer of up to 24 inputs, each with fader, pan and mono.
quirks: One stereo input per track (up to 24, 6 on a new machine), mixed to the master output; each track also has its own direct output.
Solo affects the master mix only; Mute affects the master mix and the direct out; the master Gain and Master Mute never touch a direct out.
Faders are 0.5 dB per step: 0 is silence, 1 is -80 dB, 161 is 0 dB, 181 is +10 dB.
Pan is a balance control on stereo inputs and a constant-power pan on Mono ones.
Not compatible with 1.x songs: the parameter layout changed in 2.0 and old settings do not carry over.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.how: Sets the master fader in steps of 0.5 dB, from -80.5 dB (the lowest step is silence) to +10 dB.
parameters.sound: Moves the level of the whole mix.

parameters.name: Master Mute
parameters.description: Mute master output; fades over Inertia
parameters.how: Mutes the master output, fading over the Inertia time.
parameters.sound: The whole mix fades out or back in without a click.

parameters.name: Inertia
parameters.description: Fade time for every mute and solo, in milliseconds (0 = instant)
parameters.how: Sets the fade time of every mute and solo, from 0 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: At 0 the switches are instant; longer times fade smoothly.

track_parameters.name: Solo
track_parameters.description: Solo this track. Takes effect on the master mix only, not on the direct out.
track_parameters.how: Solos this input in the master mix only; direct outs are not affected.
track_parameters.sound: Only soloed inputs are heard in the master mix.

track_parameters.name: Mute
track_parameters.description: Mute this track. Applies to the master mix AND the direct out; fades over Inertia.
track_parameters.how: Mutes this input in the master mix and its direct out, fading over Inertia.
track_parameters.sound: The input fades out of the mix.

track_parameters.name: Volume
track_parameters.how: Sets this input's fader in steps of 0.5 dB, from -80.5 dB (the lowest step is silence) to +10 dB.
track_parameters.sound: Balances this input against the others.

track_parameters.name: Pan
track_parameters.description: Pan (0 = full left, 64 = centre, 128 = full right). Balance law on stereo channels, constant-power on mono.
track_parameters.how: Pans this input from full left (0) through the centre (64) to full right (128).
track_parameters.sound: Moves the input across the stereo field.

track_parameters.name: Mono
track_parameters.description: Sum L+R to mono before the fader and pan
track_parameters.how: Sums this input's left and right to mono before the fader and pan.
track_parameters.sound: A stereo source collapses to the centre of its pan position.
